Set BLE Configuration.enable_ble: Enable BLE scanning with the required ble.enable field.
Set BLE Configuration.enable_with_interval: Enable BLE scanning and set the scan interval.
Set BLE Configuration.enable_with_rssi_filter: Enable BLE scanning with a minimum RSSI filter.
Set BLE Configuration.enable_with_protocols: Enable BLE scanning with protocol-specific filters and service UUID filters.

Start RFID Inventory or BLE scan.Start Inventory (RFID-only default): Initiates a standard RFID inventory scan. Omitting the payload or the scanType parameters defaults to an RFID-only run.
Start RFID Inventory or BLE scan.Start BLE Only: Initiates a dedicated Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) scan. Note: Requires BLE configuration to be set up first using set_bleConfig.
Start RFID Inventory or BLE scan.Start BLE and RFID: Initiates both RFID inventory and BLE beacon scanning simultaneously to run concurrent physical workflows.
Start RFID Inventory or BLE scan.Start Inventory with ImpinjGen2X: Starts an RFID inventory optimized with advanced Impinj Gen2X properties. Setting this to true is incompatible with BLE scanning.
